title: viola × savatieri var. multifida
intro: Viola × savatieri var. multifida, commonly known as the multifida viola, is a hybrid plant species within the Violaceae family, resulting from the cross between Viola savatieri and another unknown viola species. The multifida viola is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as arthritis and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Viola × savatieri var. multifida are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit antimicrobial activities, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of infections and autoimmune diseases. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been isolated and studied for their potential medicinal applications.
